title: feat(types): arm the seven registered node types that pass the criterion — page kinds, app-schema-renderer, object-pivot, embeddable-form, detail-section (objectui#11440)
body:
Part of #11440

Clause-②: yes

The first of objectui#11440's two pull requests. It arms the seven registered node types that the seat ruling `5945530142` on objectui#10859 (as amended by `5945583855`) passes: the spec page kinds `record`, `home` and `utility`, and `app-schema-renderer`, `object-pivot`, `embeddable-form` and `detail-section`. `safeValidateSchema`, and so `objectui validate`, refused each one with `invalid_union` at `type`. `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` falls 8 to 1. The eighth key, `spec-report`, is the fold into `report`, which is the second pull request (see "What is left" below).

Dispatched run: claim `5954845613` (`domain:ui` seat 1), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`. Draft, left for the seat.

## What changed

| key | arm | shape |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `record`, `home`, `utility` | `PageKindNodeSchema` (`layout.zod.ts`), its own arm of `AnyComponentSchema` | every member is `PageNodeSchema`'s own, by reference (the spec's `PageSchema` fields among them, through `SpecPageFields`); `type` is the spec's `PageTypeSchema` narrowed with `.extract` to the three kinds `@object-ui/components` registers on `PageRenderer` |
| `app-schema-renderer` | `AppSchemaRendererNodeSchema` (`app.zod.ts`), its own arm | `basePath` and `mobileNavMode` (`'drawer'` or `'bottom_nav'`), from the registration's inputs; `children` and `body` refused by name |
| `object-pivot` | `ObjectPivotBlockSchema` (`objectql.zod.ts`), in `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` | a REQUIRED `properties` bag of the registration's inputs (the cross-tab members are the `pivot` mirror's own, by reference; `drillDown` refuses `mode`; the retired `dataProvider` is refused); flat props refused by name toward `properties.KEY`; `dataSource` binding and `responsiveStyles` on the node; `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` unless `dataSource.object` names the object |
| `embeddable-form` | `EmbeddableFormBlockSchema` (`objectql.zod.ts`), same union | a REQUIRED bag of exactly the registration's inputs (`formId` required), built as above |
| `detail-section` | `DetailSectionNodeSchema` (`views.zod.ts`), in `ViewComponentSchema` | the ten `DetailViewSectionSchema` members the registration publishes, `.pick`ed by reference, flat; `fields` required |

Also:
- `object-pivot`'s registration publishes `drillDown` as an input (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`). `ObjectPivotTable` reads it, and the `pivot` node's refusal of `drillDown` names this block as where a pivot drill is authored.
- `@object-ui/types` exports `ObjectPivotBlockNode` and `EmbeddableFormBlockNode`. objectui#11468 (landed during this run) derives `ObjectQLPublicBlockNode` from the union's arms, so the two arms joined it. Its `ClosedBag` closed only an optional bag, so it closes a required one too now, and no `AuthoringNode` member carries an open bag.
- Prose this change made false is amended: three docblocks (`ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig`, `DrillDownConfigSchema`, `ObjectPivotTable`'s `dataProvider` note), and pure-append dated notes on three pending changesets (`10685-drilldown-per-block.md`, `7352-drill-down-config-mirror.md`, `11468-bag-carrier-node-types.md`).
- Changesets: `.changeset/11440-arm-passing-types.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor, each new authorable spelling listed, no BREAKING banner: a pure widening) and `.changeset/11440-object-pivot-drilldown-input.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` minor).

## Contract notes

For the at-tier reviewer.

- **Widens.** `AnyComponentSchema` accepts seven `type` literals it refused at `type`, on both faces, at the root and at every child slot. `@object-ui/types/zod` exports five schemas. `@object-ui/types` exports two TypeScript node types and `AuthoringNode` gains their members. The `object-pivot` registration publishes one more input (`drillDown`).
- **Narrows.** Nothing that parsed before is refused now. Every document naming one of the seven was refused before, so the refusals inside each arm (a flat prop, a misspelt `mobileNavMode`, a missing `fields`, `drillDown.mode`) replace a refusal at `type` with a named one. The `ClosedBag` change touches only the two new bags: the objectui#11468 pin shows the other members unchanged.
- **Evidence.** Base readings below (each key refused at `type`, both faces); the new pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/passing-keys-arms-11440.test.ts` holds what each arm accepts and refuses on both faces with a lit control per refusal; `packages/cli/src/__tests__/validate-passing-keys-11440.test.ts` runs `objectui validate` end to end; each registration's inputs are pinned against its arm in the package that registers it (four new files); two ablations turn the ratchet and the pins red (below).

## Zone 2 readings — the mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Registrations: held, with one correction.** All seven are where the brief says. `app` is registered on `PageRenderer` too (with `page`), not only the three kinds; its literal is the app document's (`AppComponentSchema`). Each declaration is built from the registration's inputs; where a renderer reads a key the inputs omit, it is named below.
2. **The page kinds: held.** At the merged base `6007dd4e4` the card's probe `{ type: 'home', name, regions }` and the spec's own page document were refused at `type` on both faces, while `{ type: 'page', pageType: 'home' }` passed. After: all pass. The precedent followed is `PageNodeSchema` itself (the spec fields by reference through `specFieldsExcept`); the strict face derives from the arm like every other. On objectstack's example pages (objectstack `4e6dc233`, read only, the eleven `definePage` documents of kind `home` or `record` in `app-crm` and `app-showcase`, run through both faces by an uncommitted probe): base, 11 of 11 refused at `type` on both faces; after, none is refused at `type`, and 10 of 11 parse on both faces. The eleventh (`showcase_my_work`) passes the tolerant face, and the strict face refuses a nested `{ type: 'grid', properties: { … } }` region component as an unrecognized key (`properties`): the `grid` arm takes its props flat. That is the `grid` arm's existing posture, unchanged here: the same component inside a `type: 'page'` document is refused the same way (measured). **`app` and `list` today, unchanged here:** a spec page of kind `app` is judged by the app document's arm (the tolerant face passes it unjudged, the strict face refuses `regions`, `template`, `kind` as unrecognized keys); a spec page of kind `list` meets the `list` component's arm (refused for having no `items`, and on the strict face for `regions` and the other page keys). No new key is registered. ⚠️ A finding on the way: declaring the page node's members a second time inside `AnyComponentSchema` made `tsc` refuse the union with TS7056 (inferred type too long to serialize); `PageKindNodeSchemaType` names the arm's type by reference, so declaration emit names it.
3. **`spec-report`: not in this pull request.** Measured only: the strict face refuses `{ type: 'report', report }` as an unrecognized key (`report`), and the tolerant face passes it unjudged. The fold needs a file outside the claimed surface (below).
4. **`detail-section`: armed, not folded.** The spec's `record:details` section names its heading `label` and takes field NAMES; this node names it `title` and takes `DetailViewField` objects. The spec row refuses the README's section with `unrecognized_keys` on `title` and `invalid_type` on each field object (pinned). After arming, the plugin-detail README's `detail-view` document validates except for one issue, at `tabs.1.content.items`: its second tab hands `record:activity` a host feed (`items: activityData`), which objectui#11321 refuses by name in a JSON document, and whose refusal text names this README as the TSX composition where it stays legal. Measured both ways by `objectui validate` (the first tab alone: valid; the full document: that one issue). The README is not edited.
5. **`app-schema-renderer`: the guide's node validates; the `schema` input is not declared.** The governed guide teaches the node's `mobileNavMode` key, in prose, and `{ type: 'app-schema-renderer', mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav' }` validates on both faces after. The registration declares three inputs. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry: `SchemaRenderer` strips the `schema` key and hands the component the NODE as its `schema` prop, so a node with its navigation under `schema` drew no navigation, and the same navigation written on the node drew. A node's `children` drew nothing either. So the arm declares `basePath` and `mobileNavMode` and refuses both content channels; where the app document belongs on this node is an open question for the seat (below). No `skills/**` edit.
6. **Namespaced twins: none armed; the pin holds at 362.** The seven twins are `ui:home`, `ui:record`, `ui:utility`, `layout:app-schema-renderer`, `plugin-dashboard:object-pivot`, `plugin-form:embeddable-form`, `plugin-detail:detail-section`. Each is its own literal, so the bare arm does not claim it; the ratchet row asserts each twin is still refused at `type`.
7. **The objectui#8347 ceiling-pin tests: not tripped** (types suite green on the head). objectui#11468 and objectui#11478 landed during the run and were merged in; the first needed the two node types above.

## Reverse verification

- **Base, predicted and read.** At `6007dd4e4` each of the seven was refused with one `invalid_union` at `type` on both faces, and the ratchet read 8.
- **Ablation 1, the page kinds.** `PageKindNodeSchema` removed from the root union by `ablation-replace` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob moved), the pin files run, the file restored. Predicted: the ratchet goes red with the three kinds. Read: 3 files red, 14 rows; "`objectui validate` refuses 4 registered bare key(s) at `type`; the pin is 1. Refused: home, record, spec-report, utility". Restore proven: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2, a declared plugin key.** `ObjectPivotBlockSchema` removed from `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` the same way. Read: 2 files red, 15 rows; "Refused: object-pivot, spec-report". Restore proven the same way.
- The first attempt at both was a no-op, and is reported as one: the replacement text was a prefix of the anchor, so the tool refused (replacement count did not rise) and restored without running anything. The readings above are the second attempt, with replacement text that was not in the file.
- **Ablation 3, the `report` wrapper:** belongs to the second pull request.

## What is left (the second pull request)

The `spec-report` fold, in the ruled step order (`report` declares the wrapper shape, `DrillDownDrawer` moves to `report`, then the alias goes), needs one file the claim does not name: `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` registers a lazy `spec-report` stub beside `report-viewer`, and an unregistered key with a surviving console stub strands that stub. Per the brief, that waits for the seat to amend the claim; it is not started here.

## Acceptance notes

- `object-pivot` and `embeddable-form` registrations still declare `objectName` `required: true`, while both renderers are gate-wrapped and the arms accept `dataSource.object` instead. The parser tier's verdict on a binding-only node was not measured here; objectui#10392 is the calendar instance of the same shape.
- `EmbeddableForm` reads config keys its registration does not publish (`branding`, `thankYouPage`, the anti-spam keys and others). The arm declares the registration's inputs only, so the strict face refuses them as unrecognized keys.
- `PageRenderer` derives its layout from `pageType`, defaulting to `record`, and not from `type`, so a kind node rendered outside `PageView` (which writes both) would draw the record layout. Read from the source, not measured.
- The plugin-dashboard README and `plugin-dashboard.mdx` describe `object-pivot` as an "internal wrapper around `ObjectPivotTable`"; it is a Tier A public block with an arm now.
